title: Ex Ōre Equī · Diēs Veneris, Īd. Nov. (Fri 13 Nov 2026)
summary: Canberra: 11–30°, partly cloudy, showers and a thunderstorm chance this afternoon; 14–28° and showers tomorrow. Australia: Albanese at COP31 in Antalya: 'real and rapid progress is possible', no mention of 'fossil fuels'; warnings that power prices could nearly double by 2029 as coal plants close; McKenzie: 'Chris Bowen is living in an alternative reality'; O'Neil: 'We have to move towards renewables'. Iran: Trump: 'We don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed'; Vance told to focus on crime and corruption in Democrat-run cities; Rezaei: talk of talks in Qatar 'a pure lie', Hormuz shut until the seven conditions are met. US: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier guard Spc. Thomas Iglesias reprimands Hegseth's group; Pentagon backs him; Hegseth awards him the Joint Service Commendation Medal. Ukraine: large prisoner exchange agreed after Abu Dhabi; Witkoff and Kushner meet Putin in the Kremlin, Zelensky next. Good news: Maple the puppy home from the Middle East (Paws of War). Opīniō: Rusty Weiss (RedState): America 'no longer needs to bargain' with Iran. St Augustine born at Thagaste, 13 Nov 354. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; RenewEconomy, Yahoo/7News, Yeni Şafak (11 Nov); The Nightly (11 Nov); Reuters (12 Nov); Al Jazeera (11–12 Nov); AP (12 Nov); ABC News (12 Nov); Censor.NET (12 Nov); WCBD (10 Nov); RedState (12 Nov); Britannica.
lines: spl
Hello, listeners. This is Straight from the Horse's Mouth.
Salvēte, audītōrēs. Haec sunt nūntia ex ōre equī.
pl
Today is Friday, the Ides of November.
Hodiē est diēs Veneris, Īdūs Novembrēs.
pl
In the year 2026.
Annō bis mīllēsimō vīcēsimō sextō.
pl
Some say: Friday the thirteenth, an unlucky day. We are not superstitious. But we have a horseshoe, just in case.
Quīdam dīcunt: diēs Veneris, tertius decimus, diēs īnfēlīx. Nōs nōn superstitiōsī sumus. Sed soleam habēmus, sī forte.
pl
First, the weather. Then Australian affairs.
Prīmum tempestās. Deinde rēs Austrāliae.
pl
Then the world: Iran, America, Ukraine.
Deinde orbis terrārum: Īrānia, America, Ūcraīna.
pl
Then a happy story, opinion, and today in history.
Tum rēs laeta, opīniō, et hodiē in historiā.
pl
At the end, the words of the day.
In fīne, verba diēī.
en
The weather. Canberra: 30 degrees, showers and perhaps a thunderstorm in the afternoon. Tomorrow 28 and more showers.
spl
The weather.
Tempestās.
pl
First, Canberra.
Prīmum Canberra.
pl
Yesterday we said: tomorrow 30 degrees, and perhaps thunder.
Herī dīximus: crās trīgintā gradūs, et fortasse tonitrus.
pl
And so it is. Today in Canberra the sky is partly cloudy.
Et ita est. Hodiē Canberrae caelum partim nūbilum est.
pl
In the morning it is cool: 11 degrees.
Māne frīgidum est: ūndecim gradūs.
pl
In the afternoon it is hot: 30 degrees.
Post merīdiem calidum est: trīgintā gradūs.
pl
In the afternoon and evening, perhaps a shower, perhaps thunder.
Post merīdiem et vesperī, fortasse imber, fortasse tonitrus.
pl
The wind blows from the north-west, 15 to 20 kilometres an hour.
Ventus ab occidente et septentriōne flat, quīndecim ad vīgintī chiliometra in hōrā.
pl
When there is thunder, a wise animal stays in the stable.
Ubi tonitrus est, sapiēns animal in stabulō manet.
pl
Tomorrow, Saturday, showers are likely, and perhaps thunder again.
Crās, diē Sāturnī, imbrēs probābilēs sunt, et fortasse iterum tonitrus.
pl
Tomorrow morning 14 degrees, in the afternoon 28.
Crās māne quattuordecim gradūs, post merīdiem duodētrīgintā.
pl
Rain, then sun: the grass will be green and sweet.
Pluvia, deinde sōl: herba viridis et dulcis erit.
pl
Now the other cities.
Nunc cēterae urbēs.
pl
In Sydney perhaps a shower, perhaps thunder. 27 degrees.
Sydnēiae fortasse imber, fortasse tonitrus. Septem et vīgintī gradūs.
pl
In Melbourne showers. 18 degrees.
Melburnī imbrēs. Duodēvīgintī gradūs.
pl
In Brisbane thunder is likely, perhaps severe. 30 degrees.
Brisbanae tonitrus probābilis est, fortasse gravis. Trīgintā gradūs.
pl
In Perth the sky is partly cloudy. 28 degrees.
Perthī caelum partim nūbilum est. Duodētrīgintā gradūs.
pl
In Adelaide showers. 23 degrees.
Adēlāidae imbrēs. Tria et vīgintī gradūs.
pl
In Hobart the sky is cloudy. 20 degrees.
Hobartī caelum nūbilum est. Vīgintī gradūs.
pl
In Darwin perhaps a shower. 36 degrees.
Darwīnī fortasse imber. Trīgintā sex gradūs.
pl
Showers almost everywhere. Good for the grass. Less good for the flies, who hate rain.
Imbrēs ferē ubīque. Bonum herbae. Minus bonum muscīs, quae pluviam ōdērunt.
pl
That is the weather.
Haec est tempestās.
en
Australia. In Turkey, Albanese tells the climate conference that real and rapid progress is possible. At home there are warnings that power prices could nearly double by 2029.
spl
Australian affairs.
Rēs Austrāliae.
pl
Yesterday we said: new loans for houses fell 15 and a half per cent.
Herī dīximus: nova mūtua prō domibus cecidērunt quīndecim per centum et dīmidium.
pl
And the interest rate is high, and the hay is dear.
Et faenus altum est, et faenum cārum est.
pl
Today Albanese is in Turkey, at the great conference on the climate.
Hodiē Albanese in Turciā est, in magnō conventū dē climate.
pl
The conference is in the city of Antalya.
Conventus est in urbe Antalya.
pl
Albanese says: real and rapid progress is possible.
Albanese dīcit: prōgressus vērus et celer fierī potest.
pl
We must go towards a future where our energy is clean, reliable and affordable.
Ad futūrum tendere dēbēmus, ubi energia nostra pūra, fīda, et vīlis est.
pl
But in his speech he never said the words 'fossil fuels'.
Sed in ōrātiōne suā verba 'combustibilia fossilia' numquam dīxit.
pl
A speech about the stable, without a word about the hay.
Ōrātiō dē stabulō, sine verbō dē faenō.
pl
And at home? At home there are warnings about the price of electricity.
Et domī? Domī monent dē pretiō ēlectricitātis.
pl
The price of electricity could nearly double, by the year 2029.
Pretium ēlectricitātis paene duplicārī potest, usque ad annum bis mīllēsimum vīcēsimum nōnum.
pl
Why? Because coal power stations are closing faster than new renewable projects are being built.
Cūr? Quia stātiōnēs ēlectricae carbōnis celerius clauduntur quam nova opera renovābilia aedificantur.
pl
Bridget McKenzie, of the Coalition, says: Chris Bowen is living in an alternative reality.
Bridget McKenzie, ē Coalitiōne, dīcit: Chris Bowen in mundō aliēnō vīvit.
pl
And McKenzie says: here at home, wholesale prices are expected to double.
Et McKenzie dīcit: hīc domī, pretia mercātōria duplicārī exspectantur.
pl
But the minister Clare O'Neil says: our country does not have a real choice here.
Sed ministra Clare O'Neil dīcit: patria nostra hīc vēram optiōnem nōn habet.
pl
We have to move towards renewables.
Ad energiam renovābilem prōcēdere dēbēmus.
pl
And O'Neil says: we have given households price relief of up to about 450 dollars.
Et O'Neil dīcit: familiīs auxilium dedimus, usque ad circiter quadringentōs quīnquāgintā dollarōs.
pl
A horse runs on oats, not on electricity. The price of oats has not doubled. Not yet.
Equus avēnā currit, nōn ēlectricitāte. Pretium avēnae nōndum duplicātum est. Nōndum.
pl
Albanese in Turkey, coal stations closing, the price of electricity perhaps doubled.
Albanese in Turciā, stātiōnēs carbōnis clausae, pretium ēlectricitātis fortasse duplicātum.
pl
That is the state of Australia today.
Haec est rēs Austrāliae hodiē.
en
The world. Iran: Trump says 'We don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed.' Iran says the Strait of Hormuz stays shut until its seven conditions are met.
spl
The world.
Orbis terrārum.
pl
First, Iran.
Prīmum Īrānia.
pl
Yesterday we said: Rubio says: there is no need for great battles. The blockade remains.
Herī dīximus: Rubio dīcit: magnīs proeliīs nōn est opus. Obsidiō manet.
pl
And Rezaei says: not even one particle of uranium will leave Iran.
Et Rezaei dīcit: nē ūna quidem particula ūraniī Īrāniam relinquet.
pl
Today Trump says: we don't need a deal with Iran.
Hodiē Trump dīcit: pactiōne cum Īrāniā nōn egēmus.
pl
Those days have long since passed.
Illī diēs iam diū praeteriērunt.
pl
We have their money, hundreds of billions of dollars, and we have their Strait!
Pecūniam eōrum habēmus, centēna mīlliarda dollarōrum, et Fretum eōrum habēmus!
pl
Trump writes 'Strait' with a capital letter. We measured the letter. It is large.
Trump 'Fretum' magnā litterā scrībit. Litteram mēnsī sumus. Magna est.
pl
No deal. In the stable we say: he who has the hay needs no deal.
Nūlla pactiō. In stabulō dīcimus: quī faenum habet, pactiōne nōn eget.
pl
And Vice-President Vance? He was working on talks with Iran.
Et Vance, vicārius praesidis? Dē sermōnibus cum Īrāniā labōrābat.
pl
Now Trump wants Vance to turn his complete attention to crime and corruption in cities run by the Democrats.
Nunc Trump vult Vance tōtum animum ad scelera et corruptiōnem in urbibus Dēmocratārum vertere.
pl
And Iran? Rezaei says: talk of talks, or of a meeting in Qatar, is a pure lie.
Et Īrānia? Rezaei dīcit: dē sermōnibus aut dē conventū in Qatariā loquī, merum mendācium est.
pl
And the Strait of Hormuz will not open until America meets Iran's seven conditions.
Et fretum Hormuziānum nōn aperiētur, nisi America septem condiciōnēs Īrāniae explēverit.
pl
Trump says: we have the Strait. Iran keeps the Strait shut. Two owners, one Strait. Like two jockeys on one horse.
Trump dīcit: Fretum habēmus. Īrānia Fretum clausum tenet. Duo dominī, ūnum Fretum. Ut duo sessōrēs in ūnō equō.
en
America. On Veterans Day, a guard at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier told Hegseth's group to keep silence after a loud laugh. The Pentagon backed the soldier, and Hegseth gave him a medal.
pl
Now the United States of America.
Nunc Cīvitātēs Foederātae Americae.
pl
Yesterday we said: the House sent the charges against Hegseth back to a committee.
Herī dīximus: Domus crīmina contrā Hegseth ad commissiōnem remīsit.
pl
Eleven Democrats were absent. Four were in the traffic.
Ūndecim Dēmocratae aberant. Quattuor in viīs erant.
pl
Today a new story about Hegseth, the Secretary of War.
Hodiē nova fābula dē Hegseth, ministrō bellī.
pl
On Wednesday, Veterans Day, Hegseth came to the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, at Arlington.
Diē Mercuriī, diē veterānōrum, Hegseth ad sepulcrum Mīlitis Ignōtī vēnit, in coemētēriō Arlingtōniēnsī.
pl
With his wife and his staff he took photos on the steps of the tomb.
Cum uxōre et comitibus imāginēs in gradibus sepulcrī cēpit.
pl
Then a loud laugh was heard.
Deinde rīsus magnus audītus est.
pl
The guard, a junior soldier, shouted: All visitors will maintain silence and respect at all times!
Custōs, mīles gregārius, clāmāvit: Omnēs advenae silentium et reverentiam semper servābunt!
pl
He shouted, so that there would be silence. Shouting for silence: the oldest custom of the army.
Clāmāvit, ut silentium esset. Clāmor prō silentiō: mōs mīlitum antīquissimus.
pl
At the tomb, silence. Nobody laughs. Nobody neighs. Above all, nobody neighs.
Ad sepulcrum, silentium. Nēmō rīdet. Nēmō hinnit. Praesertim nēmō hinnit.
pl
The soldier is called Thomas Iglesias.
Mīles vocātur Thomas Iglesias.
pl
Sean Parnell, the Pentagon spokesman, says: the soldier correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to keep decorum.
Sean Parnell, ōrātor ministeriī bellī, dīcit: mīles rēctē et reverenter omnēs monuit, ut decōrum servārent.
pl
And Hegseth? Hegseth gave the soldier a medal, the Joint Service Commendation Medal.
Et Hegseth? Hegseth mīlitī īnsigne laudis dedit.
pl
Hegseth wrote: We love soldiers. We love standards. Well done, Specialist.
Hegseth scrīpsit: Mīlitēs amāmus. Disciplīnam amāmus. Bene fēcistī, mīles.
pl
A medal for the soldier, a lesson for the visitors, and silence at the tomb.
Īnsigne mīlitī, documentum advenīs, et silentium ad sepulcrum.
pl
But in January the Democrats will rule the House. Then perhaps the charges will come back.
Sed mēnse Iānuāriō Dēmocratae Domum regent. Tum fortasse crīmina redībunt.
en
Ukraine. Russia and Ukraine agreed a large prisoner exchange. Then Trump's envoys Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in the Kremlin; next they meet Zelensky.
pl
Now Ukraine.
Nunc Ūcraīna.
pl
Yesterday we said: in the city of Abu Dhabi the talks have ended. No peace yet.
Herī dīximus: in urbe Abu Dhabi sermōnēs fīnītī sunt. Nūlla pāx adhūc.
pl
And perhaps a thousand prisoners for a thousand.
Et fortasse mīlle captīvī prō mīlle.
pl
Today: the Russians and the Ukrainians have agreed on a large exchange of prisoners.
Hodiē: Russī et Ūcraīnī dē magnā permūtātiōne captīvōrum cōnsēnsērunt.
pl
Medinsky and Umerov confirmed it. The number has not yet been given.
Medinsky et Umerov id cōnfirmāvērunt. Numerus nōndum datus est.
pl
But Medinsky says: when they bring concrete proposals, we will think about them.
Sed Medinsky dīcit: cum cōnsilia certa attulerint, ea cōnsīderābimus.
pl
Then Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner flew to Moscow.
Deinde Stephanus Witkoff et Iared Kushner Moscuam volāvērunt.
pl
On Thursday they met Putin in the Kremlin.
Diē Iovis cum Putin in Kremlinō convēnērunt.
pl
In the Kremlin, Putin asked that his thanks be passed on to Trump.
In Kremlinō Putin rogāvit ut grātiae suae ad Trump ferrentur.
pl
After the Kremlin, Witkoff and Kushner will meet Zelensky, in the city of Dublin.
Post Kremlinum Witkoff et Kushner cum Zelensky convenient, in urbe Dublin.
pl
Abu Dhabi, Moscow, Dublin. These envoys travel more than a racehorse in a long season.
Abu Dhabi, Moscua, Dublin. Hī lēgātī plūs iter faciunt quam equus curriculī longō annō.
pl
A prisoner exchange, a meeting in the Kremlin, and still no peace.
Permūtātiō captīvōrum, conventus in Kremlinō, et adhūc nūlla pāx.
en
Something good. Maple, a puppy found on an army base in the Middle East, is home in America with the couple who found her, after a journey of six months.
spl
Good news.
Rēs laeta.
pl
In Kuwait, at an American camp, there were a husband and wife: Justin and Izzy Barnett.
In Kuwaitiā, in castrīs Americānīs, erant coniugēs: Justin et Izzy Barnett.
pl
At a base of allies they found a little puppy.
In castrīs sociōrum parvam catulam invēnērunt.
pl
They called her Maple. In Latin, 'acer'. A maple is a tree. The puppy is not a tree. We just note this.
Eam Maple vocāvērunt. Latīnē, 'acer'. Acer arbor est. Catula nōn est arbor. Hoc tantum notāmus.
pl
A charity, Paws of War, helped bring the puppy home.
Societās, Paws of War, catulam domum dūcere adiūvit.
pl
The journey was long: about six months.
Iter longum erat: circiter sex mēnsēs.
pl
Niki Dawson says: this was one of the biggest challenges I have ever faced.
Niki Dawson dīcit: haec ūna ē maximīs difficultātibus fuit quās umquam subiī.
pl
Now Maple is home, in America. Barnett says: we are excited for Maple to go to dog parks.
Nunc Maple domī est, in Americā. Barnett dīcit: laetī sumus quod Maple in hortōs canum ībit.
pl
A puppy flies across the world by aeroplane. A horse walks. We do not complain. Almost.
Catula per orbem āeroplanō volat. Equus ambulat. Nōn querimur. Paene.
en
Opinion. This is the view of Rusty Weiss, in RedState: Trump has made it clear that America no longer needs to bargain with Iran.
spl
Opinion.
Opīniō.
pl
This is the view of Rusty Weiss, in RedState.
Haec est sententia Rusty Weiss, in RedState.
pl
Weiss says: Trump's post makes it clear that America no longer needs to bargain with this volatile nation.
Weiss dīcit: verba Trump clārē ostendunt Americae iam nōn opus esse cum hāc gente īnstabilī pacīscī.
pl
Trump, says Weiss, is practically dismissing any need for more diplomacy.
Trump, inquit Weiss, omnem diplōmatiae necessitātem paene reicit.
pl
Why now? After the disaster in the elections, the voters want more attention on things at home.
Cūr nunc? Post clādem in comitiīs, cīvēs plūs cūrae rēbus domesticīs volunt.
pl
On the racecourse, the one in front does not bargain. He runs.
In curriculō, quī prīmus est, nōn pacīscitur. Currit.
pl
That is the opinion of Rusty Weiss.
Haec est opīniō Rusty Weiss.
en
On this day in 354 Augustine was born at Thagaste in Africa: later bishop of Hippo, author of the Confessions and the City of God.
spl
Today in history.
Hodiē in historiā.
pl
Today, in the year 354, Aurelius Augustine was born, in the town of Thagaste, in Africa.
Hodiē, annō trecentēsimō quīnquāgēsimō quārtō, Aurēlius Augustīnus nātus est, in oppidō Thagaste, in Āfricā.
pl
His mother was Monica, a Christian woman.
Māter eius erat Monica, fēmina Christiāna.
pl
The young Augustine taught rhetoric, in Carthage, in Rome, and in Milan.
Iuvenis Augustīnus rhētoricam docuit, Carthāgine, Rōmae, et Mediolānī.
pl
In Milan, in the year 387, Ambrose baptised him.
Mediolānī, annō trecentēsimō octōgēsimō septimō, Ambrosius eum baptizāvit.
pl
Later he became bishop of Hippo, in Africa.
Posteā episcopus Hippōnis, in Āfricā, factus est.
pl
He wrote the Confessions and the City of God. He died in the year 430.
Cōnfessiōnēs et Cīvitātem Deī scrīpsit. Mortuus est annō quadringentēsimō trīcēsimō.
pl
In the Confessions he tells: as a boy he stole pears. Pears, not oats. We respect that.
In Cōnfessiōnibus nārrat: puer pira fūrātus est. Pira, nōn avēnam. Hoc probāmus.
pl
Marcus and Lucius, as always, were there. But that is another story.
Mārcus et Lūcius, ut semper, aderant. Sed id alia fābula est.
en
The day in brief.
spl
Summary of the news.
Summa rērum.

In Turciā Albanese dīcit: prōgressus vērus et celer fierī potest.

Trump dīcit: pactiōne cum Īrāniā nōn egēmus.
pl

Rusty Weiss dīcit: Americae iam nōn opus est cum Īrāniā pacīscī.

Īrānia dīcit: fretum Hormuziānum nōn aperiētur.

Ad sepulcrum Mīlitis Ignōtī custōs silentium postulāvit. Hegseth eī īnsigne dedit.
pl
Russians and Ukrainians agreed on a large exchange of prisoners.
Russī et Ūcraīnī dē magnā permūtātiōne captīvōrum cōnsēnsērunt.
pl
The puppy Maple is home, in America.
Catula Maple domī est, in Americā.
